## 4 Bedroom House for Sale in Glenvista with Pool, Jacuzzi and Entertainment Area

LOVELY, UNIQUE & SPACIOUS 4-BEDROOM FAMILY HOME WITH POOL, JACUZZI & ENTERTAINMENT AREAS IN GLENVISTA  
  
Set in a peaceful pocket of sought-after Glenvista, this beautifully spacious family home offers the lifestyle every modern family dreams of — combining generous living spaces, effortless entertaining, and exciting future potential.  
  
Positioned on an impressive 821 sqm stand with 322 sqm under roof, this home is filled with natural light and designed for comfortable family living. From the moment you enter, you are welcomed by expansive open-plan living areas featuring a stylish lounge, dining room, and large entertainment space, all flowing seamlessly together to create a warm and inviting atmosphere.  
  
The modern kitchen is truly the heart of the home, boasting sleek finishes, granite countertops, a spacious centre island, kitchen nook, and ample cupboard space — perfect for family gatherings and entertaining guests.  
  
The home offers four generously sized bedrooms with built-in cupboards, laminate flooring, and quality finishes throughout. The upstairs main suite is a private retreat featuring a walk-in closet, spacious en-suite bathroom, and tranquil garden views. Three additional downstairs bedrooms are serviced by a full bathroom and guest toilet.  
  
Step outside and enjoy your own private entertainment oasis featuring:  
• Covered entertainment patio  
• Sparkling swimming pool  
• Jacuzzi  
• Spacious private garden  
  
Adding even more value, the property already includes a concrete slab foundation, creating excellent potential for a future double-storey extension.  
  
PROPERTY FEATURES:  
• 4 Spacious Bedrooms  
• 2.5 Bathrooms (Main En-suite)  
• Open-Plan Modern Kitchen  
• Lounge, Dining & Entertainment Areas  
• Swimming Pool & Jacuzzi  
• Double Garage + Carport  
• Staff Quarters/Outside Room with Bathroom  
• Storeroom  
• Fiber Ready  
• Newly Installed Electric Fencing  
• Security Gates & Burglar Bars  
• Excellent Expansion Potential  
  
With a little love and personal touch, this home can easily be transformed into something truly exceptional.  
  
Homes offering this much space, entertainment value, and future potential in Glenvista are rare — don’t miss this incredible opportunity.  
  
Contact us today to arrange your exclusive viewing.
